# The OLDEST Home Assistant the integration claims to support, for the job "Compat smoke
# (minimum Home Assistant)" in ci.yml: exactly the release hacs.json names (2024.4.0), which is
# what pytest-homeassistant-custom-component 0.13.111 pins. Python 3.12 is its minimum.
#
# Install with:  pip install -r .github/compat/min-ha.txt
#                pip install --no-deps -r .github/compat/min-ha-plugin.txt
# The plugin is installed with --no-deps on purpose: it pins a development build of mypy
# (mypy-dev==1.10.0a3) that PyPI no longer serves, so its other pins are listed here, minus mypy-dev
# and the tools that only a Home Assistant core developer needs.
#
# This file lives outside the repository root so that Dependabot does not try to bump a deliberately
# old Home Assistant. Raise it by hand, in the pull request that raises the minimum in hacs.json and
# says so in CHANGELOG.md under "Adopter action".
homeassistant==2024.4.0
# Home Assistant 2024.4 imports josepy 1.x only.
josepy==1.15.0
SQLAlchemy==2.0.29
paho-mqtt==1.6.1
numpy==1.26.0
pydantic==1.10.12
coverage==7.4.4
freezegun==1.4.0
mock-open==1.4.0
pytest==8.1.1
pytest-aiohttp==1.0.5
pytest-asyncio==0.23.6
pytest-cov==5.0.0
pytest-freezer==0.4.8
pytest-socket==0.7.0
pytest-timeout==2.3.1
pytest-unordered==0.6.0
requests-mock==1.11.0
respx==0.21.0
syrupy==4.6.1
